dedupe_keys.name: emobpy battery electric vehicle time series

description: emobpy is an open-source Python tool that creates time series for battery-electric vehicle fleets from mobility statistics, physical properties of vehicles and customisable assumptions. It derives, for each vehicle, a mobility profile of trips and locations, the driving electricity consumption, the availability of grid connections at locations, and the resulting grid electricity demand under chosen charging strategies, so that the series can be used directly as inputs to energy and power sector models. It was developed at the German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin) by Carlos Gaete-Morales and colleagues, with release archives on Zenodo. It is location independent, working from whatever national or regional mobility statistics users supply. The package is free on PyPI (version 0.6.2 of 4 December 2021) and GitLab, with Zenodo archives of releases under the MIT licence. Caveats: the last PyPI release is from 2021, and results depend on the mobility statistics supplied. emobpy supports agent-based generation of vehicle profiles, capacity planning of charging infrastructure and studies of grid impact and flexibility of electric vehicles, and complements the Swedish synthetic charging demand data catalogued here.
